0|0f1b5ca240c65ed9533f193720f337bf24fb2f2f|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"perf/x86/intel: Add new cache events table for Haswell
Haswell offcore events are quite different from Sandy Bridge.
Add a new table to handle Haswell properly.
Note that the offcore bits listed in the SDM are not quite correct
(this is currently being fixed). An uptodate list of bits is
in the patch.
The basic setup is similar to Sandy Bridge. The prefetch columns
have been removed
column2: as prefetch counting is not very reliable

column1: on Haswell. One L1 event that is not in the event list anymore
has been also removed.
- data reads do not include code reads (comparable to earlier Sandy Bridge tables)
- data counts include speculative execution (except L1 write
- remote node access includes both remote memory
- prefetches are not included in the counts for consistency
(different from Sandy Bridge
column2: which includes prefetches in the remote node)
